They are neither measured flows nor confirmed curtailments. [km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063, km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d]"],"facts":[{"claim":"System view: this is a transport-capacity setup, not evidence of lost U.S. supply or changed end-user demand. Lower 48 storage was 3,184 Bcf, 5.5% above its five-year average, while East storage was 727 Bcf, 5.1% above average; this provides a looser-than-normal inventory backdrop. The missing denominator is point-in-time regional supply, demand, measured flow, and rerouting, so no national supply/demand share can be calculated. [eia_wngsr:1788115874039669000:c7dd258cb0915a825acbed60129cdeb5e37aaf8e0ebe0021c97414369d461469]","evidence_ids":["eia_wngsr:1788115874039669000:c7dd258cb0915a825acbed60129cdeb5e37aaf8e0ebe0021c97414369d461469","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"]},{"claim":"Calendar view: today and the next seven days are below review threshold, with a largest single unchanged-schedule gap of 3,684 Dth/day at Station 860 (segment 548 BH). The forward peak is September 14–20 at that station: 868,000 Dth/day gross transport-capacity reduction and a 668,684 Dth/day conditional shortfall. This is an exposure screen, not summed lost supply, because constrained stations and segments can overlap. [km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063, km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d]","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"]},{"claim":"The comparable outage report revision cut forecast operating capacity at Station 534 South of Pool, segment 530 BH, from 1.55 million to 905,000 Dth/day, a 645,000 Dth/day (41.6%) decrease for changed periods from September 7 through October 11. This is a forecast transport-capacity revision, not proof of a physical-flow change. [km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063, km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6]","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6"]},{"claim":"The operator issued an emergent-repair notice for Station 563 Unit 1A near Centerville, Tennessee, affecting Station 860 North (segment 860 BH). It estimated up to an additional 315,000 Dth of impact and put increases at risk; the notice said previously scheduled volumes would not be curtailed. A subsequent capacity observation is still needed to confirm the operating effect.
